title: Hyouga Yui — Nine Hells Frozen
revision: Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Area burst (Damage on the three Ice circle strikes: Nine Hell's Spear 45, Glacial Shatter: Purgatory 45, Cerulean Storm: Avalanche 40 EP)
emphasis.secondary: Ground control (Increase Damage Taken 35% on Glacial Descent: Cocytus and Nine Hell's Spear's circle; Decrease Damage Taken 35% on Cocytus and 30% on Glacier's Will's tiles)
emphasis.tertiary: Self amplification (Increase Damage Given 35% on Cerulean Storm: Avalanche and Glacier's Will beside the 25% + 0.15/level bloodline passive); same +10% band as the secondaries, ranked by role, not size
emphasis.rationale: Damage is the broadest tag: three Ice rows at 40/45 EP on radius-1 circle strikes (Nine Hell's Spear, Glacial Shatter: Purgatory, Cerulean Storm: Avalanche), all ENEMIES-only, so burst is the primary and the AOE trait's home. The Ground Control trait lives in Glacial Descent: Cocytus (35% exposure and 35% guard on one 40 AP cast), Nine Hell's Spear's 35% circle exposure and Glacier's Will's 30% ground guard, so Increase Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Taken form the secondary. Increase Damage Given sits on two 35% self rows (Avalanche, Glacier's Will) beside a bloodline passive of the same tag. All three percentage routes reach +10% on two rows, so below Damage the tiers are co-equal in size: control ranks above IDG because it spans two tags and its exposure lifts allies' hits, while IDG serves the caster alone. Wound, shield and move are unsupported. Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005).

nodes.name: Permafrost Heart
nodes.flavor: The cold settles in the chest first. Everything after it strikes harder.
nodes.coverage_note: Self damage buffs 35 → 38%: Avalanche's (Ice/Water/Wind/element-less hits), Glacier's Will's (every non-pierce hit); 2 rounds after cast.

nodes.name: Weight of the Avalanche
nodes.flavor: Snow is light until all of it moves at once.
nodes.coverage_note: Damage 45 → 47 EP on Nine Hell's Spear and Glacial Shatter: Purgatory, 40 → 42 EP on Cerulean Storm: Avalanche; radius-1 circles, enemies only.

nodes.name: Buried in the Avalanche
nodes.flavor: No one digs out of the ninth winter.
nodes.coverage_note: Route total +5 Damage: Spear and Purgatory 45 → 50, Avalanche 40 → 45 EP on every enemy in the circle; 60 AP each, cooldown 7, no ally hazard.

nodes.name: Deepening Frost
nodes.flavor: Frost does not stop at the skin. It keeps going down.
nodes.coverage_note: Both self damage buffs 40% with Permafrost Heart; both rows land on the caster at cast, Avalanche's with its 60 AP strike, Glacier's Will's with its 40 AP.

nodes.name: The Glacier Advances
nodes.flavor: A glacier moves a hand's width a day and nothing in its path survives the year.
nodes.coverage_note: Amplifier route total +10%: both self buffs 35 → 45%. Guard +2%: Cocytus 37% (self, at cast) and Glacier's Will's tiles 32% (positional).

nodes.name: Cocytus Vigil
nodes.flavor: Keep watch over the frozen lake. What is held in it cannot strike back.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure 35 → 37% on Cocytus's target and Nine Hell's Spear's circle; guard 35 → 37% on Cocytus (self) and 30 → 32% on Glacier's Will's tiles.

nodes.name: Cracks in the Ice
nodes.flavor: Every surface has a seam. The cold finds it and widens it.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure 40% with Cocytus Vigil: Spear's circle vs every non-pierce hit; Cocytus's target vs element-less and caster's-highest-stat hits.

nodes.name: Nine Hells Opened
nodes.flavor: The spear does not close the wound it opens. It opens eight more.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure route total +10% (35 → 45%) on Cocytus's target and Spear's circle; +2 Damage on all three strikes (Spear and Purgatory 47, Avalanche 42 EP).

nodes.name: Rime Mantle
nodes.flavor: Rime thickens on the shoulders until blades skate off it.
nodes.coverage_note: Guard 40% with Cocytus Vigil on Cocytus (self, at cast) and 35% on Glacier's Will's circle (caster and allies on the tiles).

nodes.name: Locked in Cocytus
nodes.flavor: The lake freezes around both of you. Only one of you was ready for it.
nodes.coverage_note: Guard route total +10%: Cocytus 35 → 45%, Glacier's Will's tiles 30 → 40%; exposure +2% (39% with Cocytus Vigil) on Cocytus's target and Spear's circle.

examples.name: Buried in the Avalanche
examples.rationale: +5 Damage on all three Ice circle strikes (Nine Hell's Spear and Glacial Shatter: Purgatory 45 → 50, Cerulean Storm: Avalanche 40 → 45 EP, enemies only), with Permafrost Heart's 38% self buffs raising strikes cast in the two rounds after Avalanche or Glacier's Will (never Avalanche's own hit) before the passive applies. Cocytus Vigil is the fourth purchase because it raises the two 40 AP supports and Spear's circle exposure (exposure 37%, guard 37% / 32%) without re-touching the strike rows; Deepening Frost (self buffs 40%) is the all-in alternative.

examples.name: The Glacier Advances
examples.rationale: Both self damage buffs at the route maximum 45% (+10%): Avalanche's covers Ice, Water, Wind and element-less hits, Glacier's Will's every non-pierce hit. Cast in one turn (60 + 40 AP) they are live together for the next two rounds and compound to ×1.45 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.10 on every hit matching both, strikes, weapons and normal jutsu alike, before the passive applies; Avalanche's own hit takes neither. Cocytus Vigil is the fourth purchase so the capstone's guard secondary adds up (Cocytus 39%, Glacier's Will 34%) and exposure reaches 37%; Weight of the Avalanche (+2 Damage) is the offensive alternative.

examples.name: Nine Hells Opened
examples.rationale: Both exposures at the route maximum 45% (+10%), live for the two rounds after the cast: Nine Hell's Spear marks every enemy in its circle against every non-pierce hit, allies' and weapons' as well as the caster's; Cocytus marks one target against element-less hits and elemental hits of the caster's highest offence stat. The capstone also carries +2 Damage on the three strikes (47 / 47 / 42 EP). Permafrost Heart is the fourth purchase for 38% self buffs; Rime Mantle (guard 40% / 35%) is the defensive alternative.

examples.name: Locked in Cocytus
examples.rationale: The Cocytus specialist: both guard rows at the route maximum (+10%: Cocytus 45% self, Glacier's Will's tiles 40% for the caster and allies standing on them) and both exposures at 42% through Cracks in the Ice plus the capstone's secondary, with no Damage or self-buff purchase at all. Cracks in the Ice is the fourth purchase because it is the only way to raise exposure beside guard; Permafrost Heart (self buffs 38%, exposure 39%) is the offensive alternative.

design_notes: Node split: Permafrost Heart (+3% self Increase Damage Given) forks into a Damage route (Weight of the Avalanche → Buried in the Avalanche) and an amplifier route (Deepening Frost → The Glacier Advances). Cocytus Vigil (+2% exposure, +2% guard) forks into exposure (Cracks in the Ice → Nine Hells Opened) and guard (Rime Mantle → Locked in Cocytus). Any two Advanced Arts cost 5 or 6 BP.

Routes (RUL-2026-10-03-005): Burst +5 Damage (Weight of the Avalanche +2, Buried in the Avalanche +3) on three rows; Amplifier +10% Increase Damage Given (Permafrost Heart +3%, Deepening Frost +2%, The Glacier Advances +5%); Exposure +10% Increase Damage Taken (Cocytus Vigil +2%, Cracks in the Ice +3%, Nine Hells Opened +5%); Lake warden +10% Decrease Damage Taken (Cocytus Vigil +2%, Rime Mantle +3%, Locked in Cocytus +5%). Each percentage tag reaches two rows (45% on the 35% rows, 40% on Glacier's Will's 30% guard). Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +5, IDG +10%, IDT +10%, DDT +10%; not jointly attainable.

Recalibration from Draft 2: each capstone's primary rises from +2% to +5% (The Glacier Advances IDG, Nine Hells Opened IDT, Locked in Cocytus DDT), moving all three percentage routes from +7% to the +10% band; secondaries and every other node are unchanged. Row-weighted full builds now run 24–36; Burst (29) sits below the percentage-route examples (32–36) because Damage is hard-capped at +5.

Why a single-tag root: the self side carries only IDG (Avalanche, Glacier's Will) and DDT (Cocytus, Glacier's Will). Guard or exposure on Permafrost Heart would push that tag past +10% in a 4-BP build with the Cocytus route, so Permafrost Heart takes IDG alone at +3% (Deepening Frost +2% is the thin step and chiefly the amplifier route's gate) and the Cocytus root owns both control tags.

Resolver (SOURCE_MECHANICS §3, §3b): Avalanche's IDG row (Ice/None/Water/Wind) raises Ice, Water, Wind and element-less hits; Glacier's Will's IDG and both DDT rows (four stat types, no element) act on every non-pierce hit given or taken, as does Spear's exposure; Cocytus's (Highest, no element) covers element-less hits plus elemental hits of the caster's highest offence stat. Kit rows multiply the hit in turn when live, reductions in sequence with a floor of 10% of the hit (computeDamagePacket); the passive applies last. IDG, IDT and DDT skip pierce.

Delivery: all cooldown 7. Strikes: 60 AP, range 4, radius-1 circle on an OTHER_USER target, friendly fire ENEMIES. Cocytus: 40 AP, OPPONENT, IDT on the target, DDT on the caster. Glacier's Will: 40 AP, EMPTY_GROUND, range 5; IDG row SELF; DDT row an INHERIT FRIENDLY ground circle re-applied each round to caster and allies on the tiles; move row sorts last (§4b). Buff/debuff rows are live in the two rounds after the cast round, never in it (§3b), so no strike takes its own jutsu's buff.

Fourth purchases: Burst takes Cocytus Vigil or Deepening Frost; Amplifier, Cocytus Vigil or Weight of the Avalanche; Exposure, Permafrost Heart or Rime Mantle; Lake warden, Cracks in the Ice or Permafrost Heart. 13 of 14 full builds are non-dominated (risk 6). User-owned option: Nine Hells Opened +1 Damage instead of +2 makes all 14 non-dominated.
risks: Classification: element-wide Ice scope (RUL-2026-10-03-005): matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu, whatever their source; sharing Ice with other bloodlines is expected. 4 of the 9 supported rows carry Ice; the rest need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Glacial Descent: Cocytus and Glacier's Will (no Ice row) qualify in-kit only through an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Ice coverage is unverified.

IDG stacking: both 35% self rows reach 45%. Avalanche (60 AP) and Glacier's Will (40 AP) fit one 100 AP turn (ENGINE_LAWS 61), so both are live for the same two rounds and compound to ×1.45 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.10 on hits matching both (§3b) before the 25% + 0.15/level passive applies. Glacier's Will's row also reaches basic attacks, weapons and normal jutsu. Not simulated; normal-tree potency unapproved.

Exposure reach: Spear's exposure (no element) raises every non-pierce hit from the caster, allies and weapons on every enemy in its circle; Cocytus's (Highest, no element) raises element-less hits and elemental hits of the caster's highest offence stat on one target. Spear and Cocytus fit one turn (60 + 40 AP), so one enemy can carry ×1.45 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.10 exposure on hits both rows cover for two rounds. Pierce hits take no exposure or guard.

Guard scale: Cocytus's 35% self guard and Glacier's Will's 30% ground guard reach 45% and 40%; both fit one turn (40 + 40 AP), so a caster on the circle takes ×0.55 × 0.60 = ×0.33 on non-pierce hits while both are live (the two reductions compound). The ground guard is positional and covers allies on the tiles; its FRIENDLY re-application and first active round follow the dossier and §4b, not a process.ts read.

Ally hazard: none on supported rows. All three Damage rows and Spear's exposure are friendly fire ENEMIES; Cocytus is an OPPONENT-target single cast; Glacier's Will's supported rows are SELF or FRIENDLY. The kit's only ally-hazard row is Spear's wound (friendly fire none) and its only enemy-hazard row is Glacier's Will's move; both are unsupported and unchanged.

Dominated allocation: 01,02,06,07 (+2 Damage, self buff +3%, exposure +5%, guard +2%) is dominated by 01,06,07,08, because Nine Hells Opened carries the same +2 Damage as Weight of the Avalanche; a player wanting both Hidden Arts' effects should buy the exposure capstone instead. Every node still appears in a non-dominated full build.

Delivery: three 60 AP strikes and two 40 AP supports, all cooldown 7, so a route's full value is realized over a seven-round cycle and the percentage routes pay only inside 2-round windows. Glacial Shatter: Purgatory is a D-rank record with the same 45 EP as the A-rank Spear, so the +5 Damage route raises it equally. No injected children, item gates, hidden jutsu or mode restrictions exist.

Context: skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and sparring. The 15% Wind Decrease Damage Taken passive is a bloodline effect and is untouched. The IDG passive is 25% + 0.15/level (28.75% if scaled at level 25; level basis unverified). The tree equalises marginal opportunity against the reference, not final strength. No combat simulation; balance values remain user-owned.

audit.revision: Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.
